bagPolicy.summary: Fenway Park has a clear bag policy to ensure guest safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) with no obscured interior pockets up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Bags and wallets exceeding the size of a small clutch bag (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
Any bag larger than the permissible size (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Fenway Park has no large stadium lot; parking is in private garages and surface lots around the Fenway and Kenmore area, typically $30-50 and pricier for big games. Prepaying through SpotHero or similar is strongly recommended. Many fans take the MBTA Green Line to Kenmore or Fenway instead.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Fenway Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Fenway Park offers a variety of food and drink options including classic comfort foods with bold flavors and modern twists. Highlights include crispy Chicken Tenders & Fries, footlong hot dogs, and specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs and Pastrami Fry. Fans can also enjoy refreshing brews at the Beer Garden.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible seating available. Elevators and ramps throughout. Contact Fenway for accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry policy varies, check your specific event.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office at Fenway. Photo ID required. Check event-specific hours.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Multiple gates including Gate A (Jersey St), B, C, D, E. Check ticket for your entry gate.
